# gcxtras_sta_program (Resource)

Manages a Genesys Cloud Speech and Text Analytics Program.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gcxtras_sta_program" "example" {
  name        = "My_Analytics_Program"
  description = "A speech and text analytics program"
  published   = true
  tags        = ["terraform", "managed"]
  topic_ids = [
    data.gcxtras_sta_topic.knowledge_gap.id,
    gcxtras_sta_topic.custom_topic.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the program.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the program.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the program should be published. When set to true, a publish job is triggered after create/update.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags associated with the program.
- `topic_ids` (List of String) List of topic IDs to associate with the program.

### Read-Only

- `default_program` (Boolean) Whether this is the default program.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
